tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Development Environment
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Set up the development environment and project structure.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project with TypeScript
2. Install and configure Tailwind CSS
3. Set up ESLint and Prettier for code quality
4. Create basic folder structure (pages, components, styles, utils)
5. Initialize Git repository and create initial commit
6. Set up environment variables for API keys and configuration
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project builds without errors and the development server runs correctly. Check that Tailwind CSS is working by adding a sample styled component.

subtasks.title: Create Next.js project with TypeScript
subtasks.description: Initialize a new Next.js project with TypeScript support using create-next-app
subtasks.details: Run 'npx create-next-app@latest --typescript' and follow the prompts. Choose to use Tailwind CSS when asked.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project runs without errors using 'npm run dev'

subtasks.title: Configure Tailwind CSS and create basic styles
subtasks.description: Set up Tailwind CSS configuration and create initial global styles
subtasks.details: Create tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js files. Update globals.css with Tailwind directives. Create a basic color scheme and typography styles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that Tailwind classes are working by applying them to a test component

subtasks.title: Set up ESLint and Prettier
subtasks.description: Install and configure ESLint and Prettier for consistent code style and quality
subtasks.details: Install eslint, prettier, and related plugins. Create .eslintrc.json and .prettierrc files with appropriate rules. Add lint and format scripts to package.json.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run linting and formatting commands to ensure they work correctly

subtasks.title: Create project folder structure
subtasks.description: Set up the basic folder structure for the project including pages, components, styles, and utils
subtasks.details: Create folders for pages, components, styles, and utils. Add placeholder files or basic implementations for each to demonstrate the structure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the folder structure is correct and that Next.js can properly resolve imports from these directories

subtasks.title: Initialize Git and set up environment variables
subtasks.description: Initialize Git repository, create initial commit, and set up environment variables for the project
subtasks.details: Initialize Git repository with 'git init'. Create .gitignore file. Make initial commit. Create .env.local file for environment variables and add placeholders for API keys and configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Ensure .gitignore is working correctly by checking that .env.local is not tracked. Verify that environment variables can be accessed in the application.

tasks.title: Implement User Authentication
tasks.description: Set up user authentication using NextAuth.js, including sign up, login, and logout functionality.
tasks.details:
1. Install NextAuth.js
2. Configure NextAuth.js with a provider (e.g., Google, GitHub)
3. Create API routes for authentication
4. Implement protected routes
5. Create login and signup pages
6. Add logout functionality
7. Store user data in the database
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration, login, and logout flows. Verify that protected routes are inaccessible without authentication. Use Jest and React Testing Library for unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Develop Project Creation Flow
tasks.description: Create the user interface and backend logic for starting a new ad project, including project metadata storage.
tasks.details:
1. Design and implement a 'New Project' page
2. Create API routes for project creation and retrieval
3. Implement project metadata storage in the database
4. Add form validation for project details
5. Create a projects dashboard for users to view and manage their projects
tasks.testStrategy: Test project creation, retrieval, and listing functionality. Ensure proper validation of input fields. Write unit tests for API routes and integration tests for the project creation flow.

tasks.title: Integrate OpenAI API for Script Generation
tasks.description: Implement the script generation feature using the OpenAI API based on user input.
tasks.details:
1. Set up OpenAI API client
2. Create an API route for script generation
3. Implement user interface for entering product description or key points
4. Send user input to OpenAI API and receive generated script
5. Allow users to edit and save the generated script
6. Implement error handling and rate limiting
tasks.testStrategy: Test script generation with various inputs. Mock OpenAI API responses for consistent testing. Verify error handling and rate limiting functionality. Write unit tests for the script generation logic.

tasks.title: Integrate Avatar Video Generation API
tasks.description: Implement the AI avatar selection and video generation feature using a third-party API (e.g., D-ID, Synthesia).
tasks.details:
1. Research and select an appropriate avatar video generation API
2. Set up API client for the chosen service
3. Create an API route for avatar selection and video generation
4. Implement user interface for avatar selection
5. Send script and avatar selection to the API and handle video generation
6. Implement progress tracking and error handling
7. Store generated avatar videos in cloud storage
tasks.testStrategy: Test avatar selection and video generation process. Mock API responses for testing. Verify proper error handling and progress tracking. Test storage and retrieval of generated videos.

tasks.title: Implement Screencast Upload and Integration
tasks.description: Develop the feature for users to upload screencasts and integrate them into the video ad.
tasks.details:
1. Set up cloud storage (e.g., AWS S3) for screencast uploads
2. Create API routes for screencast upload and retrieval
3. Implement client-side upload functionality with progress tracking
4. Add server-side validation for file type and size
5. Implement basic content moderation checks
6. Create a video compositing function to integrate screencast with avatar video
tasks.testStrategy: Test screencast upload with various file types and sizes. Verify proper storage and retrieval from cloud storage. Test integration of screencast into the video ad. Write unit tests for upload and compositing functions.

tasks.title: Add Background Music Selection Feature
tasks.description: Implement the functionality for users to choose background music or upload their own tracks.
tasks.details:
1. Create a library of royalty-free music tracks
2. Implement a music selection interface
3. Set up cloud storage for user-uploaded music
4. Create API routes for music upload, selection, and retrieval
5. Implement client-side music upload functionality
6. Add server-side validation for audio file types and sizes
7. Integrate selected or uploaded music into the video rendering pipeline
tasks.testStrategy: Test music selection from the library and user uploads. Verify proper storage and retrieval of music files. Test integration of selected music into the video ad. Write unit tests for music-related functions.

tasks.title: Develop Text Overlay Feature
tasks.description: Create the user interface and backend logic for adding and positioning text overlays on the video.
tasks.details:
1. Design and implement a text overlay editor UI
2. Create data structures to represent text overlay positions and styles
3. Implement drag-and-drop functionality for positioning text overlays
4. Add text customization options (font, size, color)
5. Create API routes to save and retrieve text overlay data
6. Integrate text overlays into the video rendering pipeline
tasks.testStrategy: Test text overlay creation, editing, and positioning. Verify proper saving and retrieval of overlay data. Test rendering of text overlays in the final video. Write unit tests for text overlay functions and integration tests for the editor UI.

tasks.title: Implement Video Rendering Pipeline
tasks.description: Develop the server-side video rendering pipeline to compose all elements into the final video ad.
tasks.details:
1. Set up ffmpeg on the server or in a cloud function
2. Create a video rendering service that combines avatar video, screencast, music, and text overlays
3. Implement a job queue system for video rendering tasks
4. Create API routes to initiate rendering and check rendering status
5. Implement error handling and retry mechanisms
6. Optimize rendering performance and resource usage
7. Store rendered videos in cloud storage with expiration policy
tasks.testStrategy: Test the entire video rendering pipeline with various combinations of inputs. Verify proper composition of all elements. Test error handling and retry mechanisms. Measure rendering performance and optimize as needed.

tasks.title: Develop Video Preview and Download Functionality
tasks.description: Implement features for users to preview the rendered video and download the final ad.
tasks.details:
1. Create a video preview component using a video player library
2. Implement API routes for video preview and download
3. Add a progress indicator for video rendering
4. Implement download functionality with proper headers and streaming
5. Create a final review page for users to preview and download their video
6. Implement error handling for failed renders or downloads
7. Add analytics tracking for video previews and downloads
tasks.testStrategy: Test video preview functionality across different browsers. Verify download functionality with various video sizes. Test error handling for failed renders. Implement end-to-end tests for the entire ad creation process, from project creation to final download.
